operations.content: Hermes runs 18 MCPs live: tavily(20-key rotator), time, filesystem, github, context7, supabase+supabase-admin(broad, explicit project_id required), vercel, cloudflare(union token), playwright, chrome-devtools, grep, ddddocr, sentry, trailcode(own map), trailcode-neocoder(portal map), vision-tool(GEMINI_API_KEY in .env), n8n via OAuth grant with refresh token.
TrailCode pinned to 0.15.0 global binary (0.25.x serves unreadable deferred tools); one server per repo map via .cmd launcher that cds into the graph folder; Hermes own map covers 8 dirs.

n8n at https://neodevstudio-n8n.hf.space: MCP door takes Connect-dialog JWT (mcp-server-api) or OAuth grant; REST API needs the separate Settings key (public-api). Web Search AI Agent + Finance Research + Playground chat agents live there.
Neocoder home is F:/CD/Opencode; its memory.jsonl stays Neocoder-only by user decision, never imported.
